content: AI slop in sales/proposal writing: buzzword stacking (delve, leverage, robust, seamless, unlock, foster, synergy), bland stock openings (we are excited to propose, leverage best practices, drive maximum value), and generic content that fails to address specific buyer pain points, underperforming manually-written proposals that show real understanding. Root cause per sources: generic prompting without discovery notes, buyer-specific pain points, account data, or proof points.
